summary: First-party English and Spanish discovery evidenced Ayuntamiento de Jerez municipal cartography and Dirección General del Catastro national cadastral services. Municipal map HTML was retrieved, but it is a map-sheet/grid presentation. Bounded anonymous Catastro requests returned HTTP 400 HTML or connection reset, so no safe parcel ID or polygon was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed queries, routes, statuses, endpoint leads, and scratch evidence paths are recorded in city-1999-jerez.json.
